Theme

School & learning · House layout, roofs, rooms & furnishings

desk noun

also school desk, writing desk, teacher’s desk

modern

Traupman 29, 123, 303

mēnsa scrīptōria

a desk, a writing table

A table for writing: mēnsa is any table, and scrīptōrius, for writing, is Celsus’s adjective (ātrāmentum scrīptōrium, writing ink: Cels. 6.4, Lewis & Short). Traupman gives mēnsa scrīptōria scholae for a school desk (p. 29).

Other words

  • pulpitum, pulpitī n. — the teacher’s desk

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Traupman 303

    Classically a platform of boards for actors, lectures and disputations (Lewis & Short); Traupman’s word for the teacher’s desk.

Examples

  • Quīdam sedent ad mēnsam, et scrībunt; ipse corrigit mendās.

    Some sit at the table and write; the master corrects their mistakes.Comen. OP 97

See also table, chair, bench, classroom, school.
